newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine stock market, banks open during APEC.
newsitem.headline: Philippine stock market, banks open during APEC.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange will remain open during the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum summit meetings despite a holiday declared by the government, an exchange official said on Friday.
The government this week declared a special holiday from November 22 to 26 to ensure Manila's normally congested streets are free of traffic jams during the meeting.
Banks' money market and foreign exchange operations will also be open on those days, the Central Bank said.
The Central Bank will have a skeleton force to look after cash and clearing operations.
APEC ministers begin their meetings in Manila on November 22 while the leaders will meet for their annual summit on November 25 at Subic, 80 kms (50 miles) north of Manila.
Ramos said important private sector service companies such as banks, hotels, restaurants and utility companies were exempt from the order. -- Manila newsroom (632) 841-8937
